review.research: English and Portuguese executed queries and official result URLs are recorded. The official 2020 PDUL assessment describes Mocuba municipal ArcGIS land records. The original MOZGIS service cache has three layers: concentration points, health facilities, and an INE 2017 locality boundary. Its saved polygon is a locality boundary, not a parcel. No public Mocuba parcel endpoint or native-ID polygon sample was qualified; access limits do not establish citywide absence.
